from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pathlib import Path
import json
SETUP="()=>{const cfg=defaultWorldConfig();cfg.regions=[regionCfg('NA',{teams:3,div2:true,system:'franchise'})];cfg.internationals=[];DB=buildWorld(cfg);const [t,o]=activeTeams(DB,'NA',1);setManagedTeam(DB,t.id);DB.world={phase:'season',year:DB.year,seed:'staff-browser',manage:'manual',registrationVersion:1,seasons:{},steps:[],step:0,offers:[],marketLog:[],pendingOfficial:null};setWorldCalendarDate(DB,DB.year+'-01-10');for(const team of activeTeams(DB)){for(const r of ROLES){const p=genPlayer(DB,new RNG('staff-browser|'+team.id+r),{region:'NA',role:r,age:22,base:65});signContract(DB,p,team,1,2,{})}initializeDepthChart(DB,team,true);team.finance.cash=1000}initializeOfficialRegistrations(DB);const cid='staff-browser-cup';DB.competitions[cid]={id:cid,name:'현장 스태프 검증 대회',region:'NA',teams:[t.id,o.id],rules:{fearless:true,staffRegistration:{max:1,lockAt:DB.year+'-01-12'}},stages:[{id:'regular',name:'정규',type:'round_robin',legs:1,bestOf:1}]};const s=newSeason(DB,cid,DB.year,'staff-browser-official',DB.year+'-01-13');s.key=cid;s.region='NA';s.div=1;DB.world.seasons[cid]=s;window.staffSeason=cid;window.staffCandidate=DB.staffPool.find(s=>s.role==='analyst').id;resetUiForWorld();VIEW='season';nav();}"
with sync_playwright() as pw:
 browser=pw.chromium.launch(executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium',headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox'])
 for width in [1280,320]:
  page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':900});errors=[];page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)));page.on('dialog',lambda d:d.accept())
  page.evaluate("()=>{const map=new Map();Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{value:{getItem:k=>map.has(k)?map.get(k):null,setItem:(k,v)=>map.set(k,String(v)),removeItem:k=>map.delete(k)}})}")
  page.set_content(Path('/workspace/LOL-GM-engine/index.html').read_text(),wait_until='load');page.wait_for_function('typeof DB!=="undefined"&&DB!==null');page.evaluate(SETUP)
  pid=page.evaluate('managedTeam(DB).roster[0]');before=page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)');page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').first.focus();page.keyboard.press('Enter');assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)')==before
  assert '공식 출전 금지는 아닙니다' in page.locator('#overlay').inner_text()
  select=page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-draft="'+pid+'"]');select.select_option('rest');page.locator('#brief-medical-close').click();assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)')==before
  assert '의료·회복' in page.evaluate('document.activeElement.textContent')
  page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').first.click();select=page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-draft="'+pid+'"]');select.select_option('rest')
  page.evaluate('(pid)=>{const el=document.createElement("select");el.dataset.medicalDraft=pid;el.innerHTML="<option value=normal>일반 훈련</option>";document.body.prepend(el)}',pid)
  page.evaluate('(pid)=>{window.medicalOldApply=document.querySelector(`#overlay [data-medical-apply="${pid}"]`).onclick}',pid)
  expected=page.evaluate('(pid)=>{const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DB));copy.players[pid].medicalPlan="rest";return JSON.stringify(copy)}',pid)
  page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-apply="'+pid+'"]').click();assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)')==expected
  page.evaluate('medicalOldApply()');assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)')==expected
  page.evaluate('(pid)=>{window.medicalPid=pid;window.medicalSource=JSON.stringify(DB.players[pid]);DB=unpackDB(packDB(DB));resetUiForWorld();nav()}',pid);assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB.players[medicalPid])')==page.evaluate('medicalSource')
  page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').first.click();page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-draft="'+pid+'"]').select_option('normal');page.evaluate('(pid)=>{window.medicalOldApply=document.querySelector(`#overlay [data-medical-apply="${pid}"]`).onclick;window.medicalOldClose=document.querySelector("#brief-medical-close").onclick;window.realMedicalDialog=UI_OVERLAY;UI_OVERLAY={kind:"club-medical"}}',pid);before=page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)');page.evaluate('medicalOldApply();medicalOldClose()');assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)')==before;assert page.evaluate('UI_OVERLAY!==realMedicalDialog');page.evaluate('UI_OVERLAY=realMedicalDialog;medicalOldClose()')
  page.evaluate('VIEW="squad";SQUAD=managedTeamId(DB);nav()');el=page.locator('[data-medical-plan="'+pid+'"]');assert el.count()==1
  page.evaluate('(pid)=>{window.medicalRosterOld=document.querySelector(`[data-medical-plan="${pid}"]`).onchange;DB=unpackDB(packDB(DB));resetUiForWorld();VIEW="squad";SQUAD=managedTeamId(DB);nav()}',pid);before=page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)');page.evaluate('medicalRosterOld()');assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB)')==before
  page.locator('[data-medical-plan="'+pid+'"]').select_option('light');assert page.evaluate('DB.players[medicalPid].medicalPlan')=='light'
  page.evaluate('VIEW="season";nav()');page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').nth(1).click();assert page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-apply]').count()==5;page.locator('#brief-medical-close').click()
  page.evaluate('DB.world.manage="ai";nav()');page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').first.click();assert page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-apply]').count()==0;page.locator('#brief-medical-close').click();page.evaluate('DB.world.manage="manual";DB.world.fired=true;nav()');assert page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').count()==0
  page.evaluate('DB.world.fired=false;nav()');page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').first.click();page.screenshot(path='/tmp/club-medical-browser-final3-'+str(width)+'.png',full_page=True)
  assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth'),'document overflow';assert not errors,errors
  print(json.dumps({'width':width,'pure':True,'scoped':True,'actualPlan':True,'save':True,'stale':True,'reserve':True,'authority':True,'keyboard':True,'errors':errors}));page.close()
 browser.close()

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pathlib import Path
import json
with sync_playwright() as p:
 browser=p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium',headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox'])
 page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1280,'height':900});errors=[]
 page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
 page.evaluate("""()=>{const map=new Map();Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{value:{getItem:k=>map.has(k)?map.get(k):null,setItem:(k,v)=>map.set(k,String(v)),removeItem:k=>map.delete(k)}})}""")
 page.set_content(Path('/workspace/LOL-GM-engine/index.html').read_text(),wait_until='load')
 page.wait_for_function('typeof DB!=="undefined" && DB!==null')
 assert page.locator('#main button').count()==3
 page.evaluate("""()=>{const cfg=defaultWorldConfig();cfg.regions=[regionCfg('NA',{teams:4,div2:true,system:'franchise'})];cfg.internationals=[];DB=buildWorld(cfg);const [a,b]=activeTeams(DB,'NA',1);setManagedTeam(DB,a.id);for(const t of [a,b])for(const r of ROLES){const player=genPlayer(DB,new RNG('browser-history|'+t.id+r),{region:t.region,role:r,age:22,base:65});signContract(DB,player,t,1,3);t.depthChart[r]=player.id;}const cid='history-cup';DB.competitions[cid]={id:cid,name:'기록 검증 대회',region:'NA',teams:[a.id,b.id],rules:{fearless:true},stages:[{id:'group',name:'풀리그',type:'round_robin',legs:2,bestOf:3}]};const s=newSeason(DB,cid,DB.year,'browser-history',DB.worldDate),day=s.days[0],m=day.matches[0];s.key=cid;DB.world={year:DB.year,seed:'browser-history',manage:'manual',phase:'season',seasons:{[s.key]:s},steps:[],step:-1,pendingOfficial:null,offers:[],marketLog:[]};window.briefKey=s.key;DB.worldDate=addDays(day.date,-1);DB.world.registrationVersion=1;const extra=genPlayer(DB,new RNG('registered-extra'),{region:'NA',role:'TOP',age:22,base:65});signContract(DB,extra,a,1,3);window.entryStarter=extra.id;initializeOfficialRegistrations(DB);resetUiForWorld();VIEW='season';nav();}""")
 page.evaluate("()=>{const t=managedTeam(DB),p=DB.players[t.roster.find(id=>DB.players[id].role==='TOP'&&id!==window.entryStarter)];window.medicalOriginal=p.id;startMedicalEvent(DB,p,'injury','moderate',10,DB.worldDate,new RNG('medical-browser-event'));window.medicalHistory=JSON.stringify(p.careerEvents);nav();}")
 page.locator('[data-brief-medical]').first.focus();page.keyboard.press('Enter');pid=page.evaluate('medicalOriginal');assert '저장된 의료 이력 1건' in page.locator('#overlay').inner_text();page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-draft="'+pid+'"]').select_option('rehab');page.on('dialog',lambda d:d.accept());page.locator('#overlay [data-medical-apply="'+pid+'"]').click();assert page.evaluate('DB.players[medicalOriginal].medicalPlan')=='rehab';assert page.evaluate('JSON.stringify(DB.players[medicalOriginal].careerEvents)')==page.evaluate('medicalHistory')
 page.locator('[data-brief-entry]').first.click();page.locator('#overlay summary').filter(has_text='공식전 선발 5명').click();page.locator('#overlay [data-official-role=TOP]').select_option(page.evaluate('window.entryStarter'));page.locator('#overlay [data-official-lineup]').click();assert page.evaluate('managedTeam(DB).registration.depthChart.TOP===window.entryStarter')
 page.locator('[data-brief-schedule]').click();assert page.evaluate('SSET.tab')=='sched';page.locator('[data-brief-return]').click();assert page.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent")=="구단 운영 브리핑"
 page.locator('[data-brief-progress=smine]').click();page.wait_for_selector('[data-choice-kind]');assert page.evaluate('!!DB.world.pendingOfficial')
 for n in range(3):
  if not page.evaluate('!!DB.world.pendingOfficial'):break
  assert not page.evaluate("navigateTo('analysis')")
  page.locator('[data-choice-kind]').first.click()
  for step in range(20):
   if page.locator('#du-finish').count():break
   page.locator('[data-du-champ]:not([disabled])').first.click();page.locator('#du-lock').click()
  assert page.locator('#du-finish').count()
  page.locator('#du-finish').click()
  if page.evaluate('!!DB.world.pendingOfficial'):
   saved=page.evaluate("""()=>{const before=DB.world.pendingOfficial.queue[0].session.games;DB=unpackDB(packDB(DB));return JSON.stringify(before)===JSON.stringify(DB.world.pendingOfficial.queue[0].session.games)}""")
   assert saved
   page.evaluate('openPendingOfficialDraft(DB)')
 assert not page.evaluate('!!DB.world.pendingOfficial')
 assert page.evaluate("DB.players[medicalOriginal].medicalDayPlan==='rehab'&&DB.players[medicalOriginal].medicalRestDays>0&&medicalOut(DB.players[medicalOriginal])")
 assert page.evaluate("DB.world.seasons[briefKey].days[0].matches[0].res.games.every(g=>g.publicRecord.sides.every(s=>s.players.every(x=>x[0]!==medicalOriginal)))")
 result=page.evaluate("""()=>{const rec=DB.world.seasons[window.briefKey].days[0].matches[0].res;LASTSER=rec;LAST=null;navigateTo('match');return {games:rec.games.length,rows:rec.games.map(g=>recordedDraftReview(DB,rec,g).rows.length)}}""")
 assert all(n==5 for n in result['rows']),result
 assert page.evaluate('DB.world.seasons[window.briefKey].days[0].matches[0].res.games.every(g=>g.publicRecord.sides.some(s=>s.players.some(x=>x[0]===window.entryStarter)))'), 'actual manual official starter reaches series result'
 endings=page.evaluate("""()=>DB.world.seasons[window.briefKey].days[0].matches[0].res.games.map(g=>{const p=g.publicRecord,e=p.ending,last=p.events.at(-1);return {winner:e.winner,duration:p.duration,minute:e.minute,second:e.second,nexusCount:p.events.filter(x=>x[2]==='nexus').length,last:last?.[2],sameTime:last?.[0]===e.minute&&last?.[1]===e.second,sourceValid:!!recordedPublicMatch(DB,DB.world.seasons[window.briefKey].days[0].matches[0].res,g).record}})""")
 assert all(e['sourceValid'] and e['nexusCount']==1 and e['last']=='nexus' and e['sameTime'] and e['duration']==e['minute']+e['second']/60 for e in endings),endings
 print(json.dumps({'actualOfficialEndings':endings}))
 page.locator('.game').first.click()
 assert '당시 확정된 경기 기록' in page.locator('.gamedetail').inner_text()
 assert '넥서스 파괴' in page.locator('.gamedetail').inner_text()
 assert '실제 주요 사건' in page.locator('.gamedetail').inner_text()
 assert '남은 체력 예산' in page.locator('.gamedetail').inner_text()
 immutable=page.evaluate('packDB(DB)')
 page.evaluate("navigateTo('analysis')")
 page.locator('[data-analysis-mode="matches"]').click()
 page.locator('#analysis-period').select_option('ALL')
 choice=page.locator('#analysis-review option').nth(1).get_attribute('value')
 page.locator('#analysis-review').select_option(choice)
 page.locator('[data-review-tab="records"]').click()
 assert '당시 확정된 경기 기록' in page.locator('main').inner_text()
 page.locator('#analysis-position').focus()
 page.locator('#analysis-position').select_option('MID')
 assert page.locator('.analysis-room table tbody tr').count()==2
 assert page.evaluate('document.activeElement.id')=='analysis-position'
 page.locator('#analysis-review').focus()
 page.keyboard.press('Tab')
 assert page.locator('#app-nav').bounding_box()['x']==0
 assert page.locator('#app-nav').bounding_box()['width']==1280
 page.screenshot(path='/tmp/club-medical-official-1280-final2.png')
 page.set_viewport_size({'width':320,'height':800})
 narrow=page.evaluate('({width:innerWidth,document:document.documentElement.scrollWidth})')
 print(page.evaluate('[...document.querySelectorAll(\"main *\")].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().right>innerWidth).slice(0,8).map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,cls:e.className,id:e.id,width:e.getBoundingClientRect().width}))'))
 assert narrow['document']<=narrow['width'],narrow
 assert page.locator('.scroll[tabindex="0"]').count()>0
 assert page.locator('#app-nav').bounding_box()['width']==320
 page.locator('#app-nav [data-v=analysis]').click()
 page.screenshot(path='/tmp/club-medical-official-320-final2.png')
 assert page.evaluate('packDB(DB)')==immutable,'review mutated world'
 page.locator('[data-review-tab="events"]').click()
 assert page.locator('.review-events li').count()>0
 page.locator('[data-review-tab="events"]').focus()
 page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
 assert page.locator('[data-review-tab="draft"]').get_attribute('aria-selected')=='true'
 page.locator('.draft-history summary').first.click()
 page.locator('[data-draft-history-kind="champ"]').first.click()
 assert page.evaluate('VIEW')=='patch'
 page.evaluate("navigateTo('analysis')")
 assert page.locator('#analysis-review').input_value()==choice
 page.locator('#analysis-patch').select_option('absent') if page.locator('#analysis-patch option[value="absent"]').count() else None
 page.evaluate("DB=unpackDB(packDB(DB));resetUiForWorld();navigateTo('analysis')")
 assert page.evaluate('ANALYSIS_SET.review')==''
 page.locator('[data-analysis-mode="matches"]').click()
 page.locator('#analysis-period').select_option('ALL')
 page.locator('#analysis-review').select_option(choice)
 page.locator('[data-review-tab="records"]').click()
 assert '당시 확정된 경기 기록' in page.locator('main').inner_text()
 page.evaluate("DB.world.fired=true;navigateTo('analysis')")
 assert page.locator('#analysis-review').count()==0
 restored=True
 assert not errors,errors
 print(json.dumps({'browser':'Chromium','actualCompleteOfficialBo3':result,'pendingAndHistorySave':restored,'storedStatsEvents':True,'analysisFilterSourceNavigation':True,'narrow':narrow,'firedPrivateOmission':True,'pageErrors':errors}))
 browser.close()
limitations: 가상 경기 검사이며 프로 보정 자료가 아니다
동일 rebuild HTML 주입·controlled localStorage이며 production HTTP·최종 기기 QA가 아니다
기존 비동기 저장 절차를 유지하며 분산탭·저장 실패 전체 callback rollback을 보장하지 않는다
